name: @aether/desktop
description: Aether Brain desktop shell (Electron): pick a vault folder, watch it, render the 3D brain.
author: Aether Brain contributors

scripts.build: pnpm build:mcp && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:renderer
scripts.dist: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never && pnpm pack:mcpb
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never && pnpm pack:mcpb
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never && pnpm pack:mcpb
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never && pnpm pack:mcpb
